row.evidence: BeyondTrust publishes no prices ("Contact our sales team to get details about pricing, request a custom quote"); its Pathfinder docs say "SCIM 2.0 provisioning lets Pathfinder automate user and group lifecycle management from an external identity provider."
row.notes: New row. BeyondTrust is a multi-product PAM suite (Pathfinder platform, Password Safe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, EPM, Entitle, Identity Security Insights); every product is quote-only, so gated follows the Contact Sales rule. The row covers the Pathfinder platform admin (app.beyondtrust.io), whose SCIM 2.0 endpoint (bearer token with admin-chosen expiry) is documented for Okta, Entra ID and SailPoint via generic SCIM apps; SAML is not required. Privileged Remote Access also has its own SCIM security provider at [host]/api/scim/v2 (one provider per site), and Password Safe/BeyondInsight and EPM have separate SCIM docs. The Okta OIN "BeyondTrust" app (2019) is SAML only, and the Entra gallery app (BeyondTrust Remote Support) is SSO with JIT. The Pathfinder REST API covers only IP allowlists; user CRUD is in the PRA Configuration API (OAuth client credentials, 20 req/s and 15,000/hour).

deprovision.notes: Okta and Entra default to PATCH active=false; DELETE /Users/{id} is a hard delete when the IdP is set to delete.

roles.how: roles attribute (custom attribute or group push); provisioned groups map to roles and application access

limitations.text: SCIM-provisioned users are federated only if their email domain matches a configured SAML provider; otherwise they sign in as local users.
Nested group support depends on release and IdP.
No IdP catalogue app with SCIM: Okta uses the generic "SCIM 2.0 Test App (Bearer Token)" and Entra a non-gallery app.
Privileged Remote Access allows only one SCIM provider per site.

auth.notes: OAuth 2 client credentials from an API account at /login > Management > API Configuration. Pathfinder's own API uses admin personal access tokens, which may need enabling by BeyondTrust.

capabilities.notes: PRA Configuration API; create covers local users only and delete only non-admins. Group policy endpoints also exist but were not reviewed.

rate_limits.text: PRA Configuration API: 20 requests per second and 15,000 per hour per API account.

limitations.text: The Pathfinder platform API exposes only IP allowlist management, not users.
Pathfinder personal access tokens may not be enabled for a site without contacting BeyondTrust.

okta.notes: OIN "BeyondTrust" app (last updated Aug. 28 2019) marks only SAML (read from page markup); SCIM goes through the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App per vendor docs.

entra.notes: Gallery app is BeyondTrust Remote Support (SP-initiated SAML with JIT); Pathfinder SCIM uses a non-gallery app.
